name: Octave
description: Sync Spotify playlists into Jellyfin, request missing albums in Lidarr, and enrich matching with ListenBrainz and Last.fm. Browser-based setup — no config file editing needed.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Stores config.json (non-secret settings: Jellyfin library ID, playlists list).

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Runtime data: SQLite sync history, credentials (settings.json), Spotify PKCE token, track cache.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Required to connect Spotify. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard, copy its Client ID here (or into Settings later), and add your Octave callback URL — http://SERVER-IP:8000/callback — to that app's Redirect URIs. PKCE is used, so no client secret is needed.

variables.name: Spotify Redirect URI
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank to let Octave infer the callback URI. Set this explicitly when using a reverse proxy, e.g. https://octave.example.com/callback.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Optional — use 'Sign in to Jellyfin' in the Settings UI to configure automatically. URL reachable from the Octave container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096 or http://jellyfin:8096.

variables.name: Jellyfin API Key
variables.description: Optional — auto-filled by 'Sign in to Jellyfin' in Settings. Jellyfin Dashboard → API Keys.

variables.name: Jellyfin User ID
variables.description: Optional — auto-filled by 'Sign in to Jellyfin' in Settings. The user ID that will own created playlists.

variables.name: Lidarr URL
variables.description: Optional — leave unset to disable Lidarr integration. URL reachable from the Octave container, e.g. http://lidarr:8686.

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: Optional Lidarr API key. Lidarr → Settings → General → Security → API Key.

variables.name: Auth Username
variables.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for the web UI. Defaults to 'octave'.

variables.name: Auth Password
variables.description: SECURITY: blank = NO authentication (anyone on the network can access Octave). Set a password before exposing Octave beyond a trusted LAN. Leave blank only for an isolated/LAN-trust setup.

variables.name: Sync Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for automatic sync (uses container TZ). Default: 2:00 AM daily. Leave blank to disable scheduled sync.

variables.name: Sync On Startup
variables.description: Set to 'true' to run a sync when the container starts.

variables.name: Sync All Playlists
variables.description: Set to 'true' to discover and sync every Spotify playlist the connected account can see. Spotify-owned editorial playlists are skipped automatically.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone string for logs and scheduled syncs, e.g. Australia/Sydney.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Python logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

variables.name: ListenBrainz Token
variables.description: Optional. ListenBrainz user token from listenbrainz.org/profile/ — enables MusicBrainz ID resolution for better Lidarr matching.

variables.name: Last.fm API Key
variables.description: Optional. Last.fm API key from last.fm/api/account/create — enables playcounts and similar-artist discovery.

variables.name: Last.fm Username
variables.description: Optional. Last.fm username for scrobble history lookups.
